name: split
summary: Arranges named start and end regions with a responsive proportion.

agent.useWhen: Two named regions need a predictable ratio at a chosen container width.
agent.avoidWhen: There are more than two peer items or regions should remain stacked at every size.

invariants: The required start and end slots preserve source order in the DOM.
Regions stack until the selected container-query breakpoint; the 'never' choice means never collapse and expands immediately.
The neutral layout adds no landmarks, controls, scripts, routes, or commands.
